name: Armenia — constitutional right of ethnic Armenians to citizenship on taking up residence, and by simplified procedure
origin_test: Being Armenian by nationality/ethnicity (ազգությամբ հայ). No ancestral degree, no residence period and no language or civics condition is stated in the Constitution itself.
instrument: Constitution of the Republic of Armenia (2015 amendments, as amended 2020)
quote_original: Ազգությամբ հայերը Հայաստանի Հանրապետությունում բնակություն հաստատելու պահից ունեն Հայաստանի Հանրապետության քաղաքացիություն ձեռք բերելու իրավունք: Ազգությամբ հայերը Հայաստանի Հանրապետության քաղաքացիությունը ձեռք են բերում օրենքով սահմանված պարզեցված կարգով:
quote_translation: Persons who are Armenian by nationality have the right to acquire citizenship of the Republic of Armenia from the moment of establishing residence in the Republic of Armenia. Persons who are Armenian by nationality acquire citizenship of the Republic of Armenia by the simplified procedure established by law.
basis: Constitution of the Republic of Armenia, Chapter 2, Article 47 (Right to citizenship of the Republic of Armenia), parts 3 and 4
notes: Read 2026-08-10 from the President of the Republic's own publication of the consolidated Constitution (president.am), which is a first-party official text. The brief pointed at "art. 11.3" — that is the numbering of the 1995/2005 Constitution; in the 2015 text in force the ethnic-Armenian limb sits at Article 47(3)-(4). The Constitution names no ancestor and no generational limit, so neither unlimited nor a maximum degree is asserted here; the ancestry evidence is demanded at the level of the implementing Government decision, not the Constitution. Note the two parts do different work: part 3 is a right that crystallises on taking up residence, part 4 sends the procedure to the Citizenship Law (see the Art. 1 and Art. 13 rows).

name: Armenia — Citizenship Law: ethnic Armenians acquire citizenship by simplified procedure
instrument: Law of the Republic of Armenia on Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia (ՀՕ-16, 6 November 1995), consolidated text
quote_original: Ազգությամբ հայերը Հայաստանի Հանրապետության քաղաքացիություն են ձեռք բերում պարզեցված կարգով:
quote_translation: Persons who are Armenian by nationality acquire citizenship of the Republic of Armenia by simplified procedure.
basis: Law on Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia, Article 1 (Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia), third paragraph
notes: arlis.am is the Armenian Legal Information System run by the Ministry of Justice; /hy/acts/218433/latest is the consolidated Citizenship Law (the same document also answers to the legacy DocumentView.aspx?docID= form). The operative content of the "simplified procedure" is Art. 13 para. 2 — see the separate row. This provision alone states the principle and is what the Constitution's Art. 47(4) refers to.

name: Armenia — naturalisation of ethnic Armenians without the residence, language or constitutional-knowledge conditions
origin_test: Being an ethnic Armenian (ազգությամբ հայ) who does not hold Armenian citizenship
instrument: Law of the Republic of Armenia on Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia (ՀՕ-16, 6 November 1995), consolidated text
quote_original: Առանց սույն հոդվածի 1-ին մասի 1-ին, 2-րդ և 3-րդ կետերով սահմանված պահանջների պահպանման՝ Հայաստանի Հանրապետության քաղաքացիություն կարող է ստանալ Հայաստանի Հանրապետության քաղաքացիություն չունեցող ազգությամբ հայ անձը կամ անգործունակ անձը, որի խնամակալը Հայաստանի Հանրապետության քաղաքացի է:
quote_translation: Without observing the requirements laid down in points 1, 2 and 3 of part 1 of this Article, citizenship of the Republic of Armenia may be obtained by a person of Armenian nationality who does not hold citizenship of the Republic of Armenia, or by a legally incapable person whose guardian is a citizen of the Republic of Armenia.
basis: Law on Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia, Article 13 (Obtaining citizenship of the Republic of Armenia), second paragraph; the disapplied conditions in Art. 13(1) are (1) three years' permanent residence, (2) ability to express oneself in Armenian and (3) knowledge of the Constitution
notes: This is the operative fast track: the three ordinary naturalisation conditions fall away on ethnicity alone. The grant is still by decree of the President (Art. 13, later paragraphs), and Art. 13's refusal grounds (threat to state and public security) continue to apply, so it is a waiver of conditions rather than an entitlement.

name: Armenia — recognition as citizens of ethnic-Armenian former Armenian-SSR citizens living outside Armenia
origin_test: Being an ethnic Armenian (ազգությամբ հայ) who was a citizen of the Armenian SSR and has acquired no other state's citizenship
instrument: Law of the Republic of Armenia on Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia (ՀՕ-16, 6 November 1995), consolidated text
quote_original: 3) Հայաստանի Հանրապետությունից դուրս բնակվող ազգությամբ հայ նախկին ՀԽՍՀ այն քաղաքացիները, ովքեր ձեռք չեն բերել այլ պետության քաղաքացիություն:
quote_translation: 3) ethnic Armenian former citizens of the Armenian SSR residing outside the Republic of Armenia who have not acquired the citizenship of another state.
basis: Law on Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia, Article 10 (Recognition of citizenship of the Republic of Armenia), point 3
notes: Recognition, not naturalisation: the person is treated as having been a citizen since the 1995 law entered into force, on production of a document confirming citizenship. relations is empty because the test attaches to the applicant's own former Armenian-SSR citizenship combined with his ethnicity, not to an ancestor. Point 2 of the same article covers stateless ethnic Armenians permanently resident in Armenia who apply before 31 December 2026 — a dated limb that is not carried as a separate row here.

name: Armenia — citizenship for an ethnic-Armenian child whose parents are not Armenian citizens
origin_test: The child is Armenian by nationality (ազգությամբ հայ); neither parent need be an Armenian citizen
instrument: Law of the Republic of Armenia on Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia (ՀՕ-16, 6 November 1995), consolidated text
articles: Art. 12.1, para. 1 (inserted by ՀՕ-251-Ն of 6 December 2017)
quote_original: 1. Ազգությամբ հայ երեխան, որի ծնողները Հայաստանի Հանրապետության քաղաքացիներ չեն, Հայաստանի Հանրապետությունում բնակություն հաստատելու (բնակչության պետական ռեգիստրում Հայաստանի Հանրապետության հասցեով հաշվառվելու) պահից ունի Հայաստանի Հանրապետության քաղաքացիություն ձեռք բերելու իրավունք:
quote_translation: 1. An ethnic Armenian child whose parents are not citizens of the Republic of Armenia has the right to acquire citizenship of the Republic of Armenia from the moment of establishing residence in the Republic of Armenia (being registered at an address in the Republic of Armenia in the state population register).
basis: Law on Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia, Article 12.1 (Citizenship of an ethnic Armenian child whose parents are not citizens of the Republic of Armenia), part 1
notes: A distinct limb worth carrying because it detaches the child entirely from parental nationality: the ethnicity is the child's own. Part 2 makes the mechanism an application for an Armenian passport with both parents' written consent.

name: Georgia — "origin from Georgia" for compatriot-living-abroad status, with a stated five-generation ancestor limit
origin_test: Belonging of the person OR of his ancestor to any ethnic group living on the territory of Georgia, plus the person's recognition of Georgia as his country of origin; alternatively (or additionally) a mother tongue belonging to the Kartvelian-Caucasian languages
instrument: Law of Georgia on Compatriots Living Abroad and Diaspora Organisations (No. 5301-IIs, 24 November 2011), consolidated text
articles: Art. 3(c) and 3(d); condition of grant at Art. 4(1)(b)
quote_original: გ) საქართველოდან წარმომავლობა – პირის ან მისი წინაპრის კუთვნილება საქართველოს ტერიტორიაზე მცხოვრები რომელიმე ეთნიკური ჯგუფისადმი და მის მიერ საქართველოს აღიარება თავის წარმომავლობის ქვეყნად; დ ) წინაპარი – პირის აღმავალი შტოს ხუთი თაობა;
quote_translation: (c) origin from Georgia — the belonging of a person or of his ancestor to any ethnic group living on the territory of Georgia and his recognition of Georgia as his country of origin; (d) ancestor — five generations of the person's ascending line.
basis: Law of Georgia on Compatriots Living Abroad and Diaspora Organisations, Article 3 (Definition of terms), sub-paragraphs (c) and (d); Article 4(1)(b) makes "origin from Georgia and/or a mother tongue belonging to the Kartvelian-Caucasian languages" the condition for a foreign national to be granted compatriot status
notes: This is the rare case where the ceiling is stated rather than inferred: Art. 3(d) defines "ancestor" as five generations of the ascending line, so maximum_degree is 5 on the instrument's own words and unlimited is false. relations lists the three enumerated positive degrees the ceiling certainly covers; the stated ceiling runs two generations beyond great-grandparent, which the enum cannot express — read maximum_degree, not relations, for the real reach. Origin is proved by a conclusion of the competent state body, which may rely on documents, on witness statements by Georgian citizens, or on a submission by a public organisation concerned with compatriots (Art. 4(2)). Close relatives (spouse and child) get the status without having to prove origin at all (Art. 6(10)).

name: Georgia — special residence permit for foreign nationals holding compatriot-living-abroad status
origin_test: Holding the status of compatriot living abroad, which under the Compatriots Law rests on origin from Georgia (person or ancestor within five generations) and/or a Kartvelian-Caucasian mother tongue
instrument: Law of Georgia on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons (No. 2045-IIs, 5 March 2014), consolidated text
quote_original: ამ კანონის მე-60 მუხლით გათვალისწინებულ პირებზე და უცხოეთში მცხოვრები თანამემამულის სტატუსის მქონე სხვა სახელმწიფოს მოქალაქეზე;
quote_translation: ...to the persons provided for in Article 60 of this Law and to a citizen of another state holding the status of a compatriot living abroad;
basis: Law of Georgia on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 15 (Types of residence permit), sub-paragraph "ვ" (special residence permit), final limb
notes: This is what turns the compatriot certificate from a courtesy document into an immigration route: the special residence permit is issued to a foreign national holding compatriot status. The quote is the closing limb of a long sub-paragraph that also covers trafficking victims and ministerial-initiative cases; it is quoted from its end so the excerpt is contiguous and free of the „ entities that appear mid-paragraph. Art. 21(2) of the same Law makes loss of compatriot status a ground for terminating the permitted stay. Separately, Art. 11 of the Compatriots Law gives status-holders 30 days' visa-free entry and a reduced fee on a citizenship application, but no residence right of its own. On unlimited/maximum_degree: the Aliens Law itself states no generational limit — the ceiling of five generations is imported from Art. 3(d) of the Compatriots Law, which defines the status this permit is issued against, and is recorded here for that reason rather than inferred.

name: Georgia — simplified grant of citizenship to holders of repatriate status (1940s deportees and their direct descendants)
origin_test: Holding repatriate status, which is open to a person forcibly deported from the Georgian SSR in the 1940s and to his direct descendant
instrument: Organic Law of Georgia on Georgian Citizenship (No. 2319-IIs, 30 April 2014), consolidated text
quote_original: 2. ამ კანონის მე-12 მუხლის მოთხოვნები არ ვრცელდება რეპატრიანტის სტატუსის მქონე პირისათვის საქართველოს მოქალაქეობის გამარტივებული წესით მინიჭებაზე.
quote_translation: 2. The requirements of Article 12 of this Law do not apply to the grant of Georgian citizenship by simplified procedure to a person holding repatriate status.
basis: Organic Law of Georgia on Georgian Citizenship, Article 14 (Grant of Georgian citizenship by simplified procedure), paragraph 2; the disapplied Article 12 carries the ordinary naturalisation conditions (continuous lawful residence, knowledge of the state language, of Georgian history and of the basics of law)
notes: The Organic Law on Citizenship contains no ethnic or ancestral test of its own — "წარმომავლობა" (origin) appears in it only in the anti-discrimination clause — so the origin content of this route is entirely imported from the Repatriation Law, which is carried as its own row. Note that repatriate status could only be applied for until 1 January 2010, so this limb is now open only to those who already hold the status.

name: Georgia — repatriate status for persons deported from the Georgian SSR in the 1940s and their direct descendants (application window closed 1 January 2010)
origin_test: Being a person forcibly deported from the Georgian SSR to other Soviet republics under USSR State Defence Committee decision No. 6279ss of 31 July 1944, or a direct descendant of such a person
instrument: Law of Georgia on the Repatriation of Persons Forcibly Displaced from the Georgian SSR by the Former USSR in the 1940s (No. 5261-rs, 11 July 2007), consolidated text
articles: Art. 3(1); definition of "forcibly deported person" at Art. 2(a); transitional deadline at Art. 11-1
quote_original: 1. ამ კანონით დადგენილი წესით რეპატრიანტის სტატუსის მოსაპოვებლად შესაბამისი განაცხადის წარდგენის უფლების მქონე პირები არიან: იძულებით გადასახლებული პირი და მისი პირდაპირი შთამომავალი.
quote_translation: 1. The persons entitled to submit an application to obtain repatriate status under the procedure established by this Law are: a forcibly deported person and his direct descendant.
basis: Law on the Repatriation of Persons Forcibly Displaced from the Georgian SSR by the Former USSR in the 1940s, Article 3 (Persons entitled to submit an application to obtain repatriate status), paragraph 1
notes: This is the Meskhetian deportation of 1944; the class is defined by descent from a deportee, which is a national-origin test and not a nationality preference. "Direct descendant" is written without a generational qualifier, so no ceiling is asserted and unlimited is left null rather than claimed from silence. CLOSED: the transitional provision (Art. 11-1) fixed the deadline set by Art. 4(7) and Art. 5(5) at 1 January 2010, so no new applications for repatriate status can be lodged; the status already granted continues to feed the citizenship route at Art. 14(2) of the Organic Law on Citizenship. Spouses and minor children may apply only alongside the qualifying relative (Art. 3(2)).

name: Kyrgyzstan — citizenship at birth for a child born in Kyrgyzstan to foreign-citizen parents who are ethnic Kyrgyz
origin_test: Both parents (or the sole parent) are foreign citizens who are ethnic Kyrgyz (этнические кыргызы); the child is born on Kyrgyz territory
instrument: Law of the Kyrgyz Republic of 21 May 2007 No. 70 "On citizenship of the Kyrgyz Republic", consolidated text (edition of 18 March 2025)
quote_original: 5. Ребенок, родившийся на территории Кыргызской Республики, родители или единственный родитель которого являются иностранными гражданами - этническими кыргызами, является гражданином Кыргызской Республики.
quote_translation: 5. A child born on the territory of the Kyrgyz Republic whose parents, or sole parent, are foreign citizens who are ethnic Kyrgyz, is a citizen of the Kyrgyz Republic.
basis: Law on citizenship of the Kyrgyz Republic, Article 12 (Acquisition of citizenship of the Kyrgyz Republic by birth), part 5
notes: Automatic citizenship keyed to the parents' ETHNICITY rather than their nationality — the parents are expressly foreign citizens. This is the sharpest form of the origin test in the region. A note at the end of Art. 12 excludes persons who have reached majority and are foreign citizens. cbd.minjust.gov.kg is the Ministry of Justice's centralised database of legal information. Its human-readable page for this act (https://cbd.minjust.gov.kg/202103/edition/29242/ru) is a React shell that returns 200 with 85 characters of text and no legal content, so the citation is the site's own JSON endpoint, which serves the consolidated text of edition 80 (in force from 18 March 2025) of document 202103. Edition ids were read from https://cbd.minjust.gov.kg/api/v1/GetDocument?DocumentCode=202103.

name: Kyrgyzstan — admission to citizenship of ethnic Kyrgyz with no residence requirement and no prior renunciation
origin_test: Being an ethnic Kyrgyz (этнический кыргыз) holding a foreign citizenship or stateless
instrument: Law of the Kyrgyz Republic of 21 May 2007 No. 70 "On citizenship of the Kyrgyz Republic", consolidated text (edition of 18 March 2025)
quote_original: 2. Лица, являющиеся этническими кыргызами, имеющие гражданство иностранного государства, или без гражданства, принимаются в гражданство Кыргызской Республики без предъявления условия о сроке проживания на территории Кыргызской Республики и без соблюдения условий, предусмотренных статьей 13 и частью 1 настоящей статьи, в установленные законодательством сроки.
quote_translation: 2. Persons who are ethnic Kyrgyz holding the citizenship of a foreign state, or stateless, are admitted to citizenship of the Kyrgyz Republic without the condition as to the period of residence on the territory of the Kyrgyz Republic and without observance of the conditions provided for by Article 13 and by part 1 of this Article, within the time limits established by legislation.
basis: Law on citizenship of the Kyrgyz Republic, Article 14 (Admission to citizenship of the Kyrgyz Republic by simplified procedure), part 2; the disapplied Article 13 carries the five-year residence, lawful income, language and constitutional-knowledge conditions
notes: Not a nationality preference: part 1 of the same article is the nationality/biography-based simplified route (parent who is a Kyrgyz citizen resident in Kyrgyzstan; birth in the Kirghiz SSR or the Kyrgyz Republic and/or former USSR citizenship; restoration), and part 2 sits above it and disapplies it. The next sentence of part 2 adds that admission proceeds without prior release from the other state's citizenship, on a written declaration renouncing it. Art. 35(2) also exempts ethnic Kyrgyz from the state duty and consular fees. The law does not define "ethnic Kyrgyz" or set any generational limit, so nothing is asserted for unlimited or maximum_degree. cbd.minjust.gov.kg is the Ministry of Justice's centralised database of legal information. Its human-readable page for this act (https://cbd.minjust.gov.kg/202103/edition/29242/ru) is a React shell that returns 200 with 85 characters of text and no legal content, so the citation is the site's own JSON endpoint, which serves the consolidated text of edition 80 (in force from 18 March 2025) of document 202103. Edition ids were read from https://cbd.minjust.gov.kg/api/v1/GetDocument?DocumentCode=202103.

name: Kyrgyzstan — simplified admission of a child of ethnic Kyrgyz whose parents are foreign citizens
origin_test: Being the child of ethnic Kyrgyz, both of whose parents (or sole parent) are foreign citizens
instrument: Law of the Kyrgyz Republic of 21 May 2007 No. 70 "On citizenship of the Kyrgyz Republic", consolidated text (edition of 18 March 2025)
quote_original: 4) ребенок этнических кыргызов, оба родителя или единственный родитель которого являются иностранными гражданами, - по заявлению одного из родителей и при наличии письменного согласия другого родителя.
quote_translation: 4) a child of ethnic Kyrgyz, both of whose parents or whose sole parent are foreign citizens — on the application of one of the parents and with the written consent of the other parent.
basis: Law on citizenship of the Kyrgyz Republic, Article 14 (Admission to citizenship of the Kyrgyz Republic by simplified procedure), part 3, point 4; part 3 admits the listed persons without the conditions of Article 13(1)
notes: Covers the child who does not qualify under Art. 12(5) because he was not born on Kyrgyz territory. The other points of Art. 14(3) are parental-citizenship or guardianship limbs and are not origin tests. cbd.minjust.gov.kg is the Ministry of Justice's centralised database of legal information. Its human-readable page for this act (https://cbd.minjust.gov.kg/202103/edition/29242/ru) is a React shell that returns 200 with 85 characters of text and no legal content, so the citation is the site's own JSON endpoint, which serves the consolidated text of edition 80 (in force from 18 March 2025) of document 202103. Edition ids were read from https://cbd.minjust.gov.kg/api/v1/GetDocument?DocumentCode=202103.

name: Uzbekistan — statutory definition of "compatriot" (соотечественник) as a descendant of persons born or formerly resident in Uzbekistan
origin_test: Being a person, or a relative in the direct descending line of a person, born or formerly resident on the territory of Uzbekistan, not holding Uzbek citizenship and living abroad, provided that his relatives in the direct ascending line live in Uzbekistan and are Uzbek citizens
instrument: Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan of 13 March 2020 No. ZRU-610 "On citizenship of the Republic of Uzbekistan", consolidated text
quote_original: соотечественник — лицо и его родственники по прямой нисходящей линии, родившиеся или ранее проживавшие на территории Республики Узбекистан, не состоящие в гражданстве Республики Узбекистан, проживающие за пределами территории Республики Узбекистан при условии, если их родственники по прямой восходящей линии проживают на территории Республики Узбекистан и являются гражданами Республики Узбекистан;
quote_translation: compatriot — a person and his relatives in the direct descending line, born or formerly resident on the territory of the Republic of Uzbekistan, not holding citizenship of the Republic of Uzbekistan, living outside the territory of the Republic of Uzbekistan, on condition that their relatives in the direct ascending line live on the territory of the Republic of Uzbekistan and are citizens of the Republic of Uzbekistan;
basis: Law "On citizenship of the Republic of Uzbekistan", Article 3, definition of "соотечественник"; the definition is operative through Article 20 (simplified admission to citizenship)
notes: This is the definition that carries Uzbekistan's origin route, and it is a national-origin test rather than an ethnic one: the qualifying link is descent from someone born or formerly resident on Uzbek territory, not self-identification as Uzbek. Two conditions narrow it hard — the applicant must live abroad and must have a living direct ascendant who resides in Uzbekistan AND holds Uzbek citizenship — so it is not a diaspora-wide entitlement. No generational limit is stated for the descending line, so neither unlimited nor a maximum degree is claimed. lex.uz is the National Database of Legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan (Ministry of Justice); the Russian text of this law is served as an official version, though some later amendments elsewhere on the site carry a LexUz note that the Russian rendering is an unofficial translation of the Uzbek original.

name: Uzbekistan — simplified admission to citizenship for compatriots
origin_test: Being a "compatriot" as defined in Art. 3 (descent from a person born or formerly resident in Uzbekistan), plus at least one direct ascendant resident in Uzbekistan holding Uzbek citizenship
instrument: Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan of 13 March 2020 No. ZRU-610 "On citizenship of the Republic of Uzbekistan", consolidated text
quote_original: Упрощенный порядок приема в гражданство Республики Узбекистан осуществляется в отношении соотечественника, являющегося гражданином иностранного государства или лицом без гражданства, если он:
quote_translation: The simplified procedure of admission to citizenship of the Republic of Uzbekistan is applied in respect of a compatriot who is a citizen of a foreign state or a stateless person, if he:
basis: Law "On citizenship of the Republic of Uzbekistan", Article 20 (Admission to citizenship of the Republic of Uzbekistan by simplified procedure), part 1
notes: The four conditions that follow the quoted stem are, verbatim in the same article: "а) имеет хотя бы одного родственника по прямой восходящей линии, проживающего на территории Республики Узбекистан и являющегося гражданином Республики Узбекистан;", plus a lawful source of subsistence, an undertaking to observe the Constitution, and state-language ability. Condition (a) may be waived for compatriots with high achievements in science, technology, culture or sport or with a profession of interest to Uzbekistan (Art. 20, part 2). What the simplified procedure buys is the loss of the five-year residence requirement of Art. 19; the grant still runs through the Presidential Commission on Citizenship and a Presidential decree, and the applicant must first renounce his existing citizenship against a one-year guarantee letter. The stem is quoted rather than the conditions because the lex.uz page interleaves each paragraph with site chrome ("Предложения по документу Прослушать аудио"), so only single paragraphs are contiguous.

name: Uzbekistan — two-year multiple-entry VTD visa for compatriots identifying as Uzbeks or Karakalpaks
origin_test: Being an emigrant from Uzbekistan who took foreign citizenship or became stateless, OR a foreign citizen or stateless person living abroad who identifies himself as Uzbek or Karakalpak by reason of spiritual and cultural attachment to the historical homeland or on the basis of ethnic and linguistic belonging
instrument: Regulation on the procedure for issuing invitations and granting multiple entry visas to the Republic of Uzbekistan for compatriots living abroad and members of their families, approved by Resolution of the Cabinet of Ministers of 17 April 2019 No. 326
articles: Para. 2 (Basic concepts): definitions of "соотечественники" and of the VTD visa
quote_original: соотечественники — категория лиц, определяемая в целях настоящего Положения, к которой относятся выходцы из Республики Узбекистан, выехавшие за рубеж и получившие гражданство иностранного государства или статус лица без гражданства, а также иностранные граждане или лица без гражданства, проживающие за рубежом, идентифицирующие себя как узбеки или каракалпаки в силу чувства духовной и культурной причастности к исторической Родине или исходя из этнической и языковой принадлежности, желающие поддерживать всестороннюю связь с Узбекистаном;
quote_translation: compatriots — the category of persons, defined for the purposes of this Regulation, comprising emigrants from the Republic of Uzbekistan who went abroad and acquired the citizenship of a foreign state or the status of stateless person, as well as foreign citizens or stateless persons living abroad who identify themselves as Uzbeks or Karakalpaks by virtue of a feeling of spiritual and cultural attachment to the historical Homeland or on the basis of ethnic and linguistic belonging, wishing to maintain a comprehensive connection with Uzbekistan;
basis: Regulation approved by Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 326 of 17 April 2019, paragraph 2, definition of "соотечественники"; the same paragraph defines the VTD visa as a two-year multiple-entry visa for compatriots and their family members
notes: This is the one place in Uzbek law where the test is expressly ETHNIC — self-identification as Uzbek or Karakalpak on ethnic and linguistic grounds — and it is deliberately wider than the Citizenship Law's "соотечественник", which is descent-based. What it confers is a two-year multiple-entry visa, not a residence permit and not a path to citizenship: route_kind is recorded as residence_status only because the schema has no visa category, and the row should be read as an entry status. The VTD still requires an invitation from a relative who is an Uzbek citizen permanently resident in Uzbekistan, within the first, second or third degree of direct kinship or a collateral relative (definition of "приглашающий" in the same paragraph). The definition of the visa itself reads: "въездная виза типа VTD — категория визы, выдаваемая сроком на 2 года для соотечественников и членов их семей...". Paragraph 1 was re-cast by Cabinet Resolution No. 224 of 5 May 2026 and LexUz flags the Russian rendering of that paragraph as an unofficial translation; paragraph 2, quoted here, carries no such flag.

name: Kazakhstan — simplified (registration) admission to citizenship for kandas
origin_test: Holding kandas status, which under the Migration Law is available to an ethnic Kazakh (and family members of Kazakh nationality) who has never held Kazakh citizenship
instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan of 20 December 1991 No. 1017-XII "On citizenship of the Republic of Kazakhstan", consolidated text
quote_original: 1) кандасы. постоянно проживающие на территории Республики Казахстан на законных основаниях, независимо от срока проживания;
quote_translation: 1) kandas permanently residing on the territory of the Republic of Kazakhstan on lawful grounds, irrespective of the period of residence;
basis: Law "On citizenship of the Republic of Kazakhstan", Article 16-1 (Conditions of admission to citizenship of the Republic of Kazakhstan by simplified (registration) procedure), point 1
notes: The ordinary route in Article 16 requires five years' residence (or three years' marriage); Article 16-1 removes the residence period entirely for kandas. Note the full stop after "кандасы" is in the official text, not a transcription error. Contrast point 2 of Article 16 — "граждане бывших союзных республик" with a close relative who is a Kazakh citizen — which is a nationality-plus-family preference and NOT an origin test. SOURCE-VERIFICATION BLOCKER, NOT LEGAL DOUBT. verdict is cannot_determine because adilet.zan.kz cannot be read by the quote gate, not because the provision is unclear. The host serves only the leaf certificate (CN=zan.kz, issued by "GoGetSSL G2 TLS RSA4096 SHA256 2022 CA-1", SANs zan.kz, adilet.zan.kz, base.adilet.zan.kz, zqai.kz, zanorda.kz) and sends no intermediate, so any client that does not chase the AIA URI fails the handshake. WHAT I TRIED, 2026-08-10: Bun fetch with the gate's own Chrome user-agent -> "unable to verify the first certificate" (HTTP 0, the same symptom the previous run recorded as a socket error); the same over http:// (301 to https, same failure); www.adilet.zan.kz, base.adilet.zan.kz, zanorda.kz, zan.kz -> identical failure, all on the same certificate; WebFetch -> same TLS error; openssl s_client -showcerts confirms exactly one certificate in the chain. Alternative Kazakh official hosts were tried and are not usable: www.gov.kz and egov.kz are React shells that return 200 with ~120 characters and no legal text, the gov.kz content-manager API (https://www.gov.kz/api/v1/public/content-manager/documents?lang=ru) carries ministry regulations that merely link back to adilet, legalacts.egov.kz carries draft acts rather than consolidated law, zqai.kz returns a 160-character shell, and mazhilis.parlam.kz does not resolve. THE TEXT ITSELF IS VERIFIED: macOS curl (which chases the AIA URI) fetched both documents at the URLs cited, and the quote recorded here was matched character-for-character in the fetched body. NEXT STEP for anyone re-running the gate: fetch these two URLs with a client that performs AIA chasing, or pin the GoGetSSL intermediate, and the quote will match.

name: Kazakhstan — statutory definitions of "kandas" and "ethnic Kazakh"
origin_test: Kandas: an ethnic Kazakh, and/or members of his family of Kazakh nationality, who have not previously held Kazakh citizenship and have been granted the status. Ethnic Kazakh: a foreigner or stateless person of Kazakh nationality.
instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan of 22 July 2011 No. 477-IV "On population migration", consolidated text
quote_original: 13) кандас – этнический казах и (или) члены его семьи казахской национальности, ранее не состоявшие в гражданстве Республики Казахстан, получившие соответствующий статус в порядке, установленном уполномоченным органом по вопросам миграции населения;
quote_translation: 13) kandas — an ethnic Kazakh and (or) members of his family of Kazakh nationality who have not previously held citizenship of the Republic of Kazakhstan and who have been granted the corresponding status under the procedure established by the authorised body for population migration;
basis: Law "On population migration", Article 1 (Basic concepts used in this Law), point 13; point 28 of the same article defines "этнический казах" as "иностранец или лицо без гражданства казахской национальности"
notes: This is the definition that gives the citizenship route its origin content, and it is purely ethnic: "казахской национальности", with no generational limit and no requirement of a Kazakh-citizen ancestor, so neither unlimited nor a maximum degree is asserted. Kandas status carries an admission quota and a package of settlement support; it is the gateway to Article 16-1(1) of the Citizenship Law. Point 1-1 of the same article separately defines "бывший соотечественник" (a person born in, or formerly a citizen of, the Kazakh SSR or Kazakhstan who lives abroad) — a biography test rather than an ancestry test, which is why it is not carried as an origin row. instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan of 22 July 2011 No. 477-IV "On population migration", consolidated text
quote_original: 1) карта "Ата жолы" – документ установленной формы, выдаваемый бизнес-иммигрантам либо лицам, обладающим востребованными профессиями, из числа этнических казахов на срок до десяти лет, но не более срока действия паспорта страны гражданства в порядке, установленном уполномоченным органом по вопросам миграции населения;

name: Azerbaijan — no origin limb located in the Citizenship Law or the Migration Code; the diaspora law defines an ethnic class but confers no route
instrument: Law of the Republic of Azerbaijan of 30 September 1998 No. 527-IQ "On citizenship of the Republic of Azerbaijan", consolidated text
articles: Art. 14 (admission to citizenship); checked against Art. 11-15 and against the Migration Code
quote_original: mənşəyindən, irqi və milli mənsubiyyətindən, cinsindən, təhsilindən, dinə münasibətindən, siyasi və başqa
quote_translation: ...irrespective of origin, racial and national belonging, sex, education, attitude to religion, political and other convictions...
basis: Law "On citizenship of the Republic of Azerbaijan", Article 14 (Admission to citizenship of the Republic of Azerbaijan), first paragraph
notes: WHAT IS UNRESOLVED. I could read the Azerbaijani Citizenship Law and the Migration Code in full and neither contains an ethnic or ancestral limb: Article 14 admits foreigners after five years' continuous lawful residence expressly "mənşəyindən, irqi və milli mənsubiyyətindən ... asılı olmayaraq" (irrespective of origin, racial and national belonging), and the Migration Code (https://frameworks.e-qanun.az/46/46959.pdf, 281,543 characters of extracted text) contains no occurrence of "azərbaycanlı", "soydaş" or "mənşəli" in any permit ground. WHAT IS MISSING: the Law of 27 December 2002 No. 400-IIQ "Xaricdə yaşayan azərbaycanlılarla bağlı dövlət siyasəti haqqında" DOES define an ethnic class — Art. 1.2 extends "Azerbaijanis living abroad" to persons outside Arts. 1.1.1-1.1.2 "lakin etnik, dil, mədəniyyət və ya tarixi əlaqələr baxımından özünü azərbaycanlı hesab edən şəxslərə və onların övladlarına" — but its Art. 5.2 routes citizenship acquisition by those persons straight back to the ordinary Citizenship Law, and Art. 4.4 gives them only the general rights of aliens on Azerbaijani territory under Constitution Art. 69(I). On the text I have, the diaspora law is a policy statute, not a route. I could not pin a gate-fetchable official URL for that diaspora law: e-qanun.az is a Next.js shell that returns 200 with no legal text for every /framework/ path; the readable artefacts are the PDFs at frameworks.e-qanun.az/{floor(id/1000)}/{id}.pdf, whose ids come from https://api.e-qanun.az/framework/{id} and https://api.e-qanun.az/downloadPdf/{id}. I resolved the Citizenship Law to 3187 and the Migration Code to 46959, but e-qanun exposes no working search endpoint (/searchForm, /search and /frameworks return 404; /getRelatedFrw returns 500), the DuckDuckGo fallback hit a CAPTCHA, and a scan of framework ids 3150-3450 did not surface citation 400-IIQ. NEXT STEP: resolve the diaspora law's e-qanun framework id (then the PDF URL is mechanical) and confirm against Arts. 1.2, 4.4 and 5.2 whether any implementing act attaches an immigration consequence to the "xaricdə yaşayan azərbaycanlı" class.

name: Tajikistan — no ethnic or ancestral limb located in the Constitutional Law on Citizenship; the simplified limbs are birthplace and former-USSR-citizenship tests
instrument: Constitutional Law of the Republic of Tajikistan "On citizenship of the Republic of Tajikistan", consolidated text (as amended to 1 October 2025 No. 2184)
quote_original: новобаста аз миллат, нажод, ҷинс, забон, эътиқоди динӣ, мавқеи сиёсӣ, таҳсил, вазъи иҷтимоӣ ва (ё) моддӣ
quote_translation: ...irrespective of nationality, race, sex, language, religious belief, political position, education, social and (or) material status...
basis: Constitutional Law "On citizenship of the Republic of Tajikistan", Article 14 (Admission to citizenship of the Republic of Tajikistan), part 2
notes: WHAT IS UNRESOLVED. Read in full on 2026-08-10 at the National Legislation Centre under the President of Tajikistan (mmk.tj), which is the official publisher. The law contains no ethnic-Tajik limb and no ancestral limb: Art. 14(2) makes the right to apply expressly independent of nationality/ethnicity, and the simplified route in Art. 16(1) turns on merit, on Great Patriotic War veteran status, on guardianship, or on having been BORN in the Tajik SSR and held USSR citizenship and become stateless — a personal-biography and former-nationality test, not a "what you are" test, so it scores as no origin route rather than as one. Art. 16(2) halves the residence period for a foreigner whose father or mother was a Tajik citizen at his birth or is one now, which is parental-citizenship descent (already covered by the authored-descent family) and not an origin test. WHAT IS MISSING: I searched mmk.tj for a separate compatriots statute (query "ҳамватанони") and found none; I therefore cannot exclude that an origin-based status exists in the Law on Migration or in a Government resolution I did not reach. NEXT STEP: read the Tajik Law on Migration and the residence-permit rules on mmk.tj for any "ҳамватан"/ethnic-Tajik ground. NOTE ON THE SOURCE: the mmk.tj page renders several statutes on one URL, so the article numbers above must be read within the Constitutional Law on Citizenship section of the page, not against the first "Моддаи 14" that the extracted text contains.

name: Turkmenistan — could not obtain any official full text of the Law on Citizenship
instrument: Law of Turkmenistan "On citizenship of Turkmenistan" (2013)
basis: Not established — no official text of the Law on Citizenship of Turkmenistan could be read.
notes: WHAT IS UNRESOLVED: everything. I could not obtain the text of any Turkmen statute from an official host. WHAT I TRIED, 2026-08-10: minjust.gov.tm (Ministry of Justice) is a Next.js shell — the root and /ru return 200 with 87-90 characters of extractable text and no legal content, and /ru/mmerkezi and /tk/mmerkezi (the Legal Information Centre path) return 404; turkmenistan.gov.tm/ru/laws returns 404. mejlis.gov.tm (the Mejlis, Turkmenistan's parliament) DOES publish a legislation index and I located the citizenship law in it by paging /laws/1..42?lang=ru and parsing the <h4 class="title"> entries: it is https://mejlis.gov.tm/single-law/193?lang=ru, titled "О гражданстве Туркменистана". That page, however, carries only the title and breadcrumb — no article text, no PDF and no attachment link of any kind (95,347 bytes of HTML, none of it legal text). The same is true of /single-law/226 "О миграции" and /single-law/264 "О миграционной службе". The Mejlis site also intermittently drops the connection (ECONNRESET) under repeated requests, so it should be fetched slowly. HOW FAR I GOT: I can confirm the acts exist and their official identifiers; I cannot quote a word of them. NEXT STEP: the printed "Türkmenistanyň Mejlisiniň Maglumatlary" gazette, or the Turkmen-language Adalat ministrligi portal behind its "Hukuk maglumatlar merkezi" menu, which may expose a document path that the Russian tree does not. I record NO finding either way on whether Turkmenistan has an origin-based route.
